_comment: No MCP servers are needed — legumista ships native tools (OpenAlex/Crossref/arXiv/Europe PMC/bioRxiv search, read_paper, NCBI datasets+EDirect, web search, grep/read). To plug in your OWN MCP server, add it under mcpServers and install the client with `pip install -e '.[mcp]'`. Example: "myserver": { "command": "python", "args": ["-m", "my_mcp_server"], "env": {} }
